author: Ortea, 2001

note.en: A tiny dorid of about 2.5 mm described in 2001, known here from one specimen taken at 9 m west of the Punta Mona islet.
note.es: Un doridáceo diminuto de unos 2,5 mm descrito en 2001, conocido aquí por un ejemplar tomado a 9 m al oeste del islote de Punta Mona.

evidence: GBIF: 1 preserved specimen in the region (INBio Atta collection, 2001)
WoRMS lists it for the Costa Rican Caribbean

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (INBio Atta specimen collection), Gandoca to Limón
